description: Podatki državnih omrežij GNSS is a dataset listed in INSPIRE Metadata System Slovenia, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by gu-signal.si. Two national CORS networks have been established in Slovenia, i.e.: - the SIGNAL Network (the abbreviation means: SlovenIa-Geodesy-NAvigation-Location) and - the Zero-Order Combined Geodetic Network. The SIGNAL Network provides data and services for the positioning in the national coordinate and height reference systems (CRS, HRS). Coverage: SI. The portal shows the English title as "Dataset on national CORS networks" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include GNSS, RINEX, SIGNAL, VRS, GNSS station, coordinate reference system. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-metadata-si.
